diffs.diff: header pin 15: part says USB-, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: DFRobot DFR0299 datasheet V1.0, Table 2.2 Pin Description numbers the pins counter-clockwise (DIP style): '14 USB+ USB+ DP', '15 USB- USB- DM', '16 BUSY Playing Status', with the right-row GND at '10 GND Ground' and '9 IO1'. The FN-M16P datasheet section 2 pin diagram labels the same physical positions explicitly: left row 1 VCC ... 8, right row 9 I/O1 (bottom), 10 GND, 11 I/O2, 12 ADKEY1, 13 ADKEY2, 14 USB+, 15 USB-, 16 BUSY (top). The second reading numbered the right row top to bottom (its own convention, not the datasheet's); both readings agree on the physical pin positions, and the model's pin 15 = USB- matches the vendor's numbering.
